data.body: AC amendment [important]: Specify credential precondition — read JIRA_URL/JIRA_USER/JIRA_API_TOKEN from env (matching bridge-outbound.py convention). Accept --project=DIG (default from JIRA_PROJECT env). Distinct exit codes: 2=missing credentials, 3=401 auth failure, 1=step failure, 5=cleanup failed after probe success.
